d:
The Heat defeated the Knicks, 108-105 tonight in New York. Bam Adebayo finished with a team-high 25 points along with 2 blocks and 7 rebounds for the Heat, while Giannis Antetokounmpo tallied 22 points, 23 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Jalen Brunson recorded 27 points, 8 assists and 3 rebounds. The Heat improve their record to 11-7 with the win, while the Knicks fall to 12-7 for the season.
